"P/N: 141852220024J R01 RoHS" is silkscreened on the board in the FCC photos. :This device uses two [[Skyworks]] [http://www.skyworksinc.com/uploads/documents/201849A.pdf SKY85803] Dual-Band FEMs.
*[http://www.smallnetbuilder.com/other/ces-2013/31991-buffalo-ces-2013-announcements Buffalo CES 2013 announcements - on SmallNetBuilder] :Expected to ship early 2013, ''street price'' of $69
===Drivers=== Per '''[[Buffalo]]''''s (~ 310MB) driver archive... *The ''[[Broadcom]]''' driver is the following version in each of the OS specific directories... **6.30.61.28 (dated 11/06/2012) in the '''Win XP''' directory **6.30.61.25 (dated 10/29/2012) in the '''Win 7''' directory **6.30.145.9 (dated 11/16/2012) in the '''Win 8''' directory
*The USB ID for this device is [[0411]]:022a. *The driver cites the following additional USB IDs... **0411:0222 - noted as the [[Buffalo WI-U2-400D]] **[[0a5c]]:bd1d - presumably the default BCM43526 USB ID, likely used by the [[Tenda W900U]]
